segments.name: Wearable Devices
segments.description: Develops and sells non-invasive neural input interface wristbands for controlling digital devices using hand gestures.
segments.evidence: We are a growth company developing a non-invasive neural input interface in the form of a wearable wristband for controlling digital devices using subtle finger gestures and hand movements.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase wearable neural input devices and development kits, and licensing agreements with technology companies for hardware and software integration.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025 and 2024, we had revenues of $647 thousand and $522 thousand, respectively.

changes.text: In September 2024, the company launched Mudra Link, a universal neural band, which began regular sales and shipments in February 2025.
changes.evidence: In September 2024, we launched the Mudra Link, a universal neural band to control multiple Operating Systems, or OS, devices. The Mudra Link has been sold and shipped regularly since February 2025.

changes.text: In February 2026, the company announced launch of Mudra Experience Studio, a universal single codebase Neural Input Platform for XR and AI Developers.
changes.evidence: In February 2026, we announced the launch of Mudra Experience Studio – a universal single codebase Neural Input Platform for XR and AI Developers.
